subject.title: fix(codex): clean final/yield turn close writes a false "user interrupted" marker into the thread rollout

question: Should explicit `final:true` and `sessions_yield` close immediately through `turn/interrupt`, or wait for native `turn/completed` with this PR’s 10-second fallback and immediate-new-inbound policy?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes completion timing and terminal semantics after a delivered reply; tests can verify races but cannot choose the preferred user and operator behavior.

options.title: Adopt bounded natural completion
options.body: Accept the 10-second absolute deadline and immediate-new-inbound fallback, subject to real app-server evidence.

options.title: Keep immediate interruption
options.body: Preserve existing immediate closure and accept the Codex rollout marker until an upstream graceful-stop protocol exists.

options.title: Request a narrower policy variant
options.body: Keep the clean-completion mechanism but choose a different deadline, inbound policy, or post-final output policy before merge.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded natural completion
recommendation.body: Accept the 10-second absolute deadline and immediate-new-inbound fallback, subject to real app-server evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent authoritative Codex finalization path and is best positioned to calibrate this terminal-state policy.
